summary: Vibe equalizer + song-actions iteration — PASS end-to-end. Backend regression 30/30 green (health/home/albums/album detail/search/billing-status/subscription-plans, auth incl. admin empty-password login, /auth/me, playlists CRUD + like toggle + liked list, 401 without token, POST /api/payment/azampay/initiate activates is_premium=true, admin RBAC 403 for normal user). Frontend (Expo web @ 390x844) verified: (1) Play 'Asante Bwana' from Home -> MiniPlayer (mini-player) shows with animated equalizer overlay on the artwork; testIDs mini-prev + mini-play-toggle + mini-next present and all three tap actions work (prev/pause/next). (2) Tapping mini-player opens full player: header renders 'INACHEZA KUTOKA' with album title 'Utukufu', duration correctly shown as 0:03 / 5:44 (no giant number), and the animated equalizer bars render next to song meta while playing. (3) Action row on full player: player-like, player-add, player-share, player-download all present. As GUEST, player-like and player-add open block-modal (guest reason -> 'Ingia' primary). player-share on web mobile-viewport did NOT crash (navigator.share is available under the emulated mobile UA so the code branch returns 'shared' rather than 'copied'; the 'Kiungo kimenakiliwa' toast is therefore not shown on mobile-emulated web — this matches spec that requires 'copies OR opens native share; should not crash'). (4) Album screen (via Search -> album-card) — each song row has testID song-more-<song_id> which opens SongActionsSheet with action-add, action-download, action-like, action-share all present and correctly labelled in Swahili ('Ongeza kwenye Playlist', 'Pakua', 'Penda', 'Shiriki'). Guest action-add opens block-modal; action-share on web returned to album screen without crash. (5) SongActionsSheet.action-add -> AddToPlaylistSheet mounted with new-playlist-open and pl-pick-<playlist_id> rows; picking a playlist successfully adds the song (verified from Library -> playlist detail showed 1 song). (6) Playlist detail: three-dots opens SongActionsSheet WITH the extra action-remove ('Ondoa kwenye playlist'); tapping it removed the song (0 remaining). (7) Radio -> tap station 'radio-radio_1' -> mini-player 'LIVE · Redio' -> full player shows LIVE badge, no seek bar, no huge duration, player-download hidden for live. (8) GlobalMiniPlayer now mounted at root layout so mini-player persists on /radio and other non-tab screens (previous iter_2 gap FIXED). (9) Premium flow: register free_<ts>@t.com -> /plans -> plan-plan_daily -> checkout-phone 0712345678 -> checkout-pay -> premium activated; post-premium player-like no longer opens block-modal, and library-create -> create-pl-input -> create-pl-save works. Deprecated packages detected: none blocking (only react-native-web 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning; AnimatedEqualizer.tsx line 41 still uses pointerEvents prop instead of style).

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated prop `pointerEvents="none"`. Migrate to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}`. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AnimatedEqualizer.tsx:41

action_items: (Cosmetic) In /app/frontend/src/components/AnimatedEqualizer.tsx replace `<View ... pointerEvents="none">` with `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` to silence the react-native-web deprecation warning.

(Nice-to-have) player-share on web-mobile-viewport: navigator.share is defined on the emulated UA so the code returns 'shared' and never falls back to clipboard, meaning the 'Kiungo kimenakiliwa' toast is not shown in web-mobile. If you want the toast to always appear on web, either explicitly force the clipboard branch when running in browser (Platform.OS==='web') OR show a generic 'Imeshirikiwa' toast on the 'shared' branch too. Non-blocking — spec allows either behavior.

(Optional visual polish) In SongRow, when a song is the currently-playing one, the active state renders only via COLORS.primary text + the AnimatedEqualizer at the right; on some album screens with dark album art it's subtle. Consider bumping fontWeight or adding a small dot/pill to the active row for stronger affordance.
critical_code_review_comments: GlobalMiniPlayer.tsx: mounted at app/_layout.tsx so mini-player persists across all screens (Home/Search/Radio/Plans/Library/Downloads). Previous iter_2 action-item resolved.
player.tsx L106-107: header 'INACHEZA KUTOKA' with album fallback chain (album_title -> artist_name -> 'Vibe') and 'REDIO' label when isLive — verified for both regular songs and radio streams.

SongActionsSheet.tsx L38-63: each action correctly funnels through gatePremium() for like/download/add; share via services/share.ts uses navigator.share on web with clipboard fallback (returns 'copied'|'shared'|'none') — no crash path.

playlist/[id].tsx L116: extraActions injects 'remove' with icon 'remove-circle-outline' and label 'Ondoa kwenye playlist' — testID action-remove is auto-generated from key 'remove' by SongActionsSheet's actions.map. Verified functional (song removed, count goes to 0).
MiniPlayer.tsx L15,26-34: eqOverlay only renders when isPlaying=true, using AnimatedEqualizer with color='#fff' size=16 over a 40% dark overlay on the artwork. Verified visible during playback.

SongRow.tsx L38-42: currently-playing indicator shows AnimatedEqualizer at right of the row + activeText (COLORS.primary) on title/index. testID song-row-<song_id> exposed, and testID song-more-<song_id> emitted when onMore prop is provided.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested equalizer + song-actions + premium flows verified (mini-player prev/play/next + equalizer overlay, full player INACHEZA KUTOKA header + 5:44 duration + equalizer, player action row like/add/share/download with guest+non-premium+premium gating, album song-more -> SongActionsSheet, AddToPlaylist pl-pick, playlist detail action-remove, radio LIVE badge with no seek bar, GlobalMiniPlayer persistence on non-tab screens, premium activation removes gating)

seed_data_creation: Registered fresh non-premium user free_<timestamp>@t.com / pass123 and activated premium via simulated Azam Pay (plan_daily, phone 0712345678) to exercise premium-only flows (create playlist, add song via AddToPlaylistSheet, playlist detail action-remove).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (currently https://logic-6.preview.emergentagent.com). Admin: admin@vibe.app / Vibe@2026 (or empty). Run: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_vibe_backend.py -v`. For UI tests use mobile viewport 390x844; clear localStorage between guest runs (vibe_guest_plays / vibe_guest_skips). Key testIDs added this iteration: AnimatedEqualizer inside mini-player (eqOverlay) + full player, SongActionsSheet actions -> action-add/action-download/action-like/action-share/action-remove, song-more-<song_id> on album/playlist rows, GlobalMiniPlayer at root. player-share on web: navigator.share is defined under emulated mobile UA, so toast 'Kiungo kimenakiliwa' does not appear — this is expected (fallback to native share).
rca_of_issue: No blocking bugs. Single low-severity finding: AnimatedEqualizer.tsx still uses `pointerEvents` as a prop instead of a style, producing a react-native-web deprecation warning on load (same class as iter_1/2 warnings). Non-functional; fix by moving to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}`. All the equalizer + song-actions + LIVE-radio + premium-gating flows described in the review request work as intended, and previously flagged 'MiniPlayer scoped to tabs only' from iter_2 is resolved via GlobalMiniPlayer at root.
